memory_scope: PyTorch CUDA allocator; excludes driver and other processes

inference.scope: model only; excludes disk I/O and preprocessing; CUDA synchronized

limitations: Training history scores pool pixels, not patients. Case evaluation is reported separately.
Best checkpoint selected by minimum validation CE plus foreground soft Dice loss, not by prostate Dice.
One seed and four validation Cases; test generalisation and superiority over Improved U-Net are untested.
Metrics/loss include padding; weeks pooled within each Case; physical spacing not established.
Training metrics accumulate during updates, not final-model train-set evaluation.
Training timer excludes initial validation and final reload/inference checks.
CUDA cross-entropy nondeterminism warning observed; fixed seeds do not guarantee bitwise retraining equality.
Hardware timings are single-run laptop observations, not controlled multi-run estimates.

provenance.scope: Fresh 20-epoch baseline; all training and validation slices, no test-set model evaluation.
provenance.config_samples_note: Synthetic-only default; real run used all 11460 training slices.

validation_examples.selection_policy: For each validation Case, take lower median of prostate-positive slices sorted by ground-truth prostate area, breaking ties by manifest index; no model scores used.
validation_examples.interpretation: Selected positive slices only, not representative of all slices or a complete failure analysis; CPU inference.
